name: claudetwin
description: Shared memory and handoffs between two Claude accounts via the ClaudeTwin connector.

connector_url.description: ClaudeTwin connector base URL, e.g. https://claudetwin.example.com (no trailing slash)
connector_url.title: ClaudeTwin connector URL

account_token.description: Account token for this machine's Claude account (CLAUDETWIN_WORK_TOKEN or CLAUDETWIN_PERSONAL_TOKEN)
account_token.title: Account token

env_file.title: Connector .env file (optional)
env_file.description: Used only when connector URL or token is empty: the connector .env that holds the port and both tokens
